assignments.title: Cart total calculator
assignments.brief: Functions aur arrays se shopping cart ka total nikalo.
tasks: `$cart` array mein 3 items rakho (name, price, qty)
assignments.explain: `array_map` har item ka line total banata hai, `array_sum` unka jod deta hai.

solution.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

function lineTotal(int $price, int $qty = 1): int
{
    return $price * $qty;
}

$cart = [
    ['name' => 'Mouse',    'price' => 799,  'qty' => 2],
    ['name' => 'Keyboard', 'price' => 1499, 'qty' => 1],
    ['name' => 'Cable',    'price' => 150,  'qty' => 3],
];

$total = array_sum(array_map(
    fn (array $item) => lineTotal($item['price'], $item['qty']),
    $cart
));

echo "Total: {$total}"; // 3547

assignments.title: Student class
assignments.brief: OOP se ek Student class banao jo average aur grade nikale.
tasks: Constructor promotion se `name` (readonly) aur private `marks` (array) rakho
`grade(): string` method mein `match(true)` se A/B/C do
Do students ke objects banakar result print karo
assignments.explain: `match(true)` har arm ko `true` se compare karta hai, isliye conditions likh sakte ho.

solution.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

class Student
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $name,
        private array $marks,
    ) {}

    public function average(): float
    {
        return array_sum($this->marks) / count($this->marks);
    }

    public function grade(): string
    {
        return match (true) {
            $this->average() >= 75 => 'A',
            $this->average() >= 50 => 'B',
            default => 'C',
        };
    }
}

$s = new Student('Asha', [80, 70, 90]);
echo "{$s->name}: {$s->average()} ({$s->grade()})";

interview.q: What is the difference between == and ===?
interview.a: `==` loose comparison hai (type convert karta hai). `===` strict hai: value aur type dono same hone chahiye.

interview.q: Abstract class aur interface mein farak?
interview.a: Abstract class mein implementation aur state ho sakti hai, interface sirf contract hai. Ek class kai interfaces implement kar sakti hai par extend sirf ek class ko.
Code reuse ka tareeka jo `use` se class mein aata hai, jaise `HasFactory`.
Namespace ko folder path se map karne ka standard, jisse Composer classes khud load karta hai.
`match` strict comparison karta hai, value return karta hai, fall-through nahi hota aur match na ho to `UnhandledMatchError` deta hai.
